resampling: One disk-backed native mosaic and metric DEM warp; haloed D relief; bilinear premultiplied RGB XYZ warp; aligned 2x2 alpha-weighted parent pyramid.

unsupported_mask: Complete derivative and 9x9 shading support plus full highest-zoom interpolation support; otherwise transparent. Parent alpha represents supported area fraction. No extrapolation/infill.
vertical_datum: NAVD88 metres from retained metadata; no vertical transformation
